templates.name: Still to motion
templates.description: A Soul key frame, then a Wan camera move that continues it.

nodes.title: Key frame
nodes.prompt: A lone figure under a streetlamp, warm sodium light, wet asphalt, cinematic still.

nodes.title: Camera move
nodes.prompt: Slow dolly in from the street to the figure, holding the sodium glow.

templates.name: Re-shoot then move
templates.description: Change the angle on a still, then give the new angle a camera move.

nodes.title: New angle
nodes.prompt: Orbit twenty degrees to the right and lower the camera to chest height.

nodes.title: Move the angle
nodes.prompt: Push slowly toward the subject from the new angle, keeping the room still.

templates.name: Edit, grade and score
templates.description: One edit branches into an upscale while a separate audio bed runs beside it.

nodes.title: Edit the cut
nodes.prompt: Replace the grey sky with a storm and keep the actor's timing.

nodes.title: Score the cut
nodes.prompt: A low string bed that rises under the last line.

templates.name: Product launch
templates.description: A product still and a poster pass, then a four-second launch beat.

nodes.title: Product still
nodes.prompt: A red kettle on a warm kitchen counter, steam catching the window light.

nodes.title: Poster crop
nodes.prompt: The same kettle as a vertical marketplace poster with room for a price.

nodes.title: Launch beat
nodes.prompt: Four-second product beat: the kettle steams, then the light drops to the logo.
